notes:
Version 0.1.2
- Auto Program (Toolpaths tab, beside Stock Setup): a whole first program in one click - facing, holes, pockets, chamfers, round overs and the cut out, each checked against the part.
- Auto Profile (arrow beside Contour): cuts the part out of its block, the windows that go right through first, then the outline, with a mill whose flutes reach the whole depth.
- Auto Chamfer and Auto Round Over (arrow beside Chamfer): deburr every sharp edge, and cut the chamfers and rounds your model already has, as drawn. An edge where the tool would hit the part (down a counterbore, into a shallow recess) is left out and the reason is shown.
- New tool type: corner rounding mill (roundover bit), for round overs through Chamfer. Fusion radius mills import as one.
- 3+2 Rough: rough from several planes in turn, and Find Planes picks them for you. Rest roughing and rest finishing see what the other planes cut.
- Lathe: the holder's lead angle; lathe programs read back turn on the insert's nose at their real feeds (G95/G96).
- NC import: no tool-less piece before the first tool; machine homes at one height.
- Levels tab: level sets, type the main level, select all on a level. Planes tab shows the Gview.
- Verify on every side no longer reads false gouges where a ray meets a mesh edge; Auto Chamfer on a tall part is much faster.
